title: 第五章 磨皮四关千军万马过独木桥第六章 石腰蛮脊
lines: 威远镖局。
“石头，你今日怎么来了，不在铺里干活？”
得了门房通知，从镖局偏门走出的少年，看到林砚眼中有着意外之色。
“我找你是有事情的。”
林砚开门见山，都是从小玩到大的玩伴，虽然后面婶婶搬家了，但也没断了来往。
“什么事，我能帮上忙的你尽管说。”
“我想了解和武道有关的消息，你这边有没有路子？”
“和武道有关？”
张威没想到林砚是来问这个的，好奇问道：“你想学武？”
“我从亲戚那边求了一门武道功法。”
林砚没瞒着张威，简单的说了一遍，婶婶不让小弟对外说，只是不想惹来街坊邻居的议论，而他则是不想让张大海知道。
“这样啊。”张威想了一下：“我现在只是在镖局干点杂活，接触不到那些真正的武者，不过镖局的郑师傅，年轻时候也练过一段时间拳脚，虽然没能磨皮成功，但平常两三个人不是他的对手，对武道肯定是了解的，要不晚上我约他到家里坐坐，到时候你来我家问问。”
“别去家里了，就去周家茶楼吧。”
林砚摇了摇头，有求于人去张威家里不合适。
周家茶楼点上一壶好茶加几碟点心，几十文他现在还是拿得出来的。
“周家茶楼，石头你发财了？”
“我去哪发财，有人支持我学武，给了点赞助的钱。”
“行，我现在就去问问郑师傅，你在这等我一会。”
盏茶时间后，张威去而复返：“郑师傅一听是去周家茶楼立刻就答应了，镖局这边还有三刻钟才下值。”
“嗯，我先去茶楼那边等着你们。”
周家茶楼。
林砚提前一刻钟抵达，点了一壶茶水，又点了两份点心，倒不是小气，而是准备剩下的留着那位郑师傅亲自来点。
约莫着时间差不多了，林砚起身来到门口，没一会也就看到张威与一位留着山羊胡子的中年汉子朝着这边走来。
“郑师傅，这就是我好兄弟林砚。”
林砚等张威先开口后，这才向郑镖师打招呼。
前几日在蔡府与那位周护院的一番对话，也让林砚有些反省。
自己目前才十八岁，那就该有十八岁少年接人待物的生涩，若跟个老油条一般，反倒更让人不喜。
什么久仰大名，如雷贯耳，这种话不合适。
“郑师傅，经常听威子提起您，说您在镖局中对他多有照顾，我这以茶代酒敬您一杯。”
太俗套的话不能说，但该有的奉承话语还是有的，倒是一旁的张威听的愣了一下，自己可压根没在石头面前提过郑师傅。
一番客套，林砚又道：“不知道郑师傅是否有忌口，没敢做主多点，郑师傅您看看还要加点什么？”
“我听张威说过，你得了一门武道功法，现在已经开始修炼了，若想让我指点你修炼只怕是不行，我也没这个能耐，你要是想了解关于武道的一些信息，我倒是能够告知你一二。”
郑光很是直白，他要是能够指点别人练武，也不会自己练了几年都没成，最终只能凭着力气在镖局混口饭吃。
“多谢郑师傅愿意解惑。”
林砚表示感激，郑光脸上这才露出笑容，叫来小二又点了两份点心。
“这样，你来问，不然说起来太复杂了。”
郑光夹了一块糕点入肚，林砚也不客气，他这算是异界版的知识付费，花了钱来提问的。
“郑师傅，练武之人的实力境界是怎么划分的？”
“桩功养基，而后是四次磨皮。”
林砚静静等待郑光继续讲下去，结果发现郑光停了下来喝茶，喝完之后也没再继续。
没了？
武道就两个境界？
“怎么，觉得练武很简单？”
郑光从林砚神情看出其心中所想，苦笑一下：“第一关养基，就算再无天赋也能水磨石成，但磨皮四关是千军万马过独木桥。”
content_en:
Weiyuan Escort Agency.
"Shitou, why are you here today and not working in the shop?"
After receiving the notice from the concierge, the young man who walked out of the side door of the escort office saw a look of surprise in Lin Yan's eyes.
"I have something to do with you."
Lin Yan got right to the point. They have been playmates since childhood. Although their aunt moved later, they still kept in touch with each other.
"Whatever it is, just tell me if I can help."
"I want to know some news related to martial arts. Is there any way on your side?"
"Is it related to martial arts?"
Zhang Wei did not expect that Lin Yan was here to ask this, and asked curiously: "Do you want to learn martial arts?"
"I asked for a martial arts technique from a relative."
Lin Yan didn't hide it from Zhang Wei, and simply said that his aunt didn't want his younger brother to tell the outside world, just because he didn't want to provoke comments from the neighbors, and he didn't want Zhang Dahai to know.
"That's it." Zhang Wei thought for a moment: "I am just doing some odd jobs in the escort agency now and have no contact with those real martial artists. However, Master Zheng of the escort agency also practiced boxing and kicking for a period of time when he was young. Although he failed to polish his skin successfully, two or three people are usually no match for him. He must know martial arts. Why don't I invite him to my house tonight and you can come to my house to ask."
"Don't go to home, just go to Zhou's teahouse."
Lin Yan shook his head. It was not appropriate to go to Zhang Wei's house to ask for help.
Zhou's restaurant ordered a pot of good tea and a few plates of snacks, and he could still get it for dozens of yuan.
"Zhou Family Teahouse, Shitou, have you made a fortune?"
"Where am I going to make a fortune? Someone supports me in learning martial arts and gives me some sponsorship money."
"Okay, I'm going to ask Master Zheng now. Please wait for me here for a while."
After the tea time, Zhang Wei left and came back: "Master Zheng immediately agreed when he heard that he was going to Zhou's teahouse. The escort agency still has three quarters of an hour to go."
"Well, I'll wait for you at the teahouse first."
…
Zhou Family Tea House.
Lin Yan arrived a quarter of an hour early and ordered a pot of tea and two snacks. He was not stingy, but planned to leave the rest for Master Zheng to order in person.
As soon as the time was almost up, Lin Yan got up and came to the door. After a while, he saw Zhang Wei and a middle-aged man with a goatee walking towards this side.
"Master Zheng, this is my good brother Lin Yan."
Lin Yan waited for Zhang Wei to speak first before saying hello to Bodyguard Zheng.
The conversation with Zhou Huyuan in Cai Mansion a few days ago also made Lin Yan reflect a little.
I am only eighteen years old now, so I should have the awkwardness of an eighteen-year-old boy in dealing with people. If he behaves like an old man, it will be even more unpleasant.
It is inappropriate to say that someone has admired a famous name for a long time and heard it like thunder.
"Master Zheng, I often hear Wei Zi talking about you and saying how much you took care of him in the escort agency. I would like to propose a toast to you with tea instead of wine."
I couldn't say anything too tacky, but I still had the flattering words that I should have. However, Zhang Wei on the side was stunned for a moment. He had never mentioned Master Zheng in front of Shitou.
After being polite, Lin Yan said again: "I don't know if Master Zheng has any taboos, so he doesn't dare to make more decisions. Master Zheng, can you tell me what else to add?"
"I heard Zhang Wei say that you have acquired a martial arts technique and have now begun to practice it. If you want me to guide you in your practice, I'm afraid it won't work. I don't have the ability. If you want to know some information about martial arts, I can tell you a thing or two."
Zheng Guang was very straightforward. If he could teach others how to practice martial arts, he wouldn't have been unable to succeed after practicing for several years. In the end, he could only rely on his strength to earn a living in the escort agency.
"Thank you, Master Zheng, for being willing to clear up the confusion."
Lin Yan expressed his gratitude, and a smile appeared on Zheng Guang's face, and he called the waiter to order two more snacks.
"In this case, you ask, otherwise it will be too complicated."
Zheng Guang put a piece of pastry into his stomach, and Lin Yan was not polite. He was paying for knowledge in an otherworldly way, and he spent money to ask questions.
"Master Zheng, how are the levels of strength of martial arts practitioners divided?"
"The foundation is established through pile work, followed by four skin resurfacing sessions."
Lin Yan waited quietly for Zheng Guang to continue talking, but found that Zheng Guang stopped to drink tea and did not continue after drinking.
Gone?
Are there only two realms of martial arts?
"Why, do you think practicing martial arts is easy?"
Zheng Guang could see what was in Lin Yan's mind from his expression, and smiled bitterly: "In the first level, no matter how talented you are, you can still make it with terrazzo, but in the fourth level, you need thousands of troops to cross a single-plank bridge."
